stories.title: Validate one bounded three-way decision

open_questions: S01-06 requires a second explicit saved-commitment cancellation but does not define durable intent lifetime or replay semantics. PM recommends one restart-safe current opaque intent per commitment, superseded by a newer Cancel prompt and resolved by Keep, Done, or cancellation, with no wall-clock expiry and callback `x:<uuid>:<version>:confirm_cancel|keep`. Owner approval is required.

S01-06 AC1 requires actual next-work-session and Calendar-check state, but S01-06 currently depends only on simple-reminder S01-04. PM recommends adding S01-09c to depends_on, producing the acyclic S01-04 → S01-05 → S01-09a → S01-09b → S01-09c → S01-06 sequence. Owner approval is required.

S01-05 and S01-06 both affect scheduled-message states, cancellation predicates, migrations, and database tests. PM recommends serializing S01-05, S01-09c, then S01-06 instead of concurrent shared-schema implementation. Owner approval is required.

Scope requires target-ordered status results with Done and Cancel only but does not define repeated-label action binding. Designer recommends one `Promise i of N` Telegram message per commitment with one ordered Done/Cancel row, deterministic equal-target ordering, and `No active promises.` for empty state. Owner approval is required.

Scheduler delivery, retry, continuation, recovery, or Calendar writes.

acceptance_criteria.given: a simple, ineligible, incomplete, or already-windowed intention
acceptance_criteria.then: work-session planning is not offered.
duration and supported timing constraints are collected before availability.
at most two deterministic version-bound choices are shown without private event details.
keep-conflict requires a new explicit confirmation and superseded actions are stale.

acceptance_criteria.given: a current selected or kept window
acceptance_criteria.then: one version-bound commit request is sent to the injected committer.

acceptance_criteria.then: it creates no consequence, exposes no event detail, and accepts no model-generated authority.

Owner approval is required.

PM recommends that the single conversation draft own all planning state while at most two sanitized ephemeral option rows are bound to its current ID and version, replaced or cleared atomically on every accepted version change. No second active scheduling draft is created. Owner approval is required.

If an explicitly kept conflict is free at final recheck, PM recommends that the committer receive both the final free observation and the earlier conflict-consent audit, display the final state as Free when checked, and retain the explicit keep decision only in audit history. Owner approval is required.

stories.title: Verify deployed resilience and privacy
stories.user_story: As the product owner, I want restart, replay, authorization, ambiguity, privacy, and parity verified on the pinned release, so that failures remain bounded and honest.
stories.why_now: The deployed journeys pass; resilience and privacy can now be tested without changing product contracts.
in_scope: Refuse release identity drift.
Verify scheduled work survives a dedicated-service restart once.
Verify webhook, callback, and stale-action replay.
Verify Telegram and dashboard owner boundaries.
Verify Calendar, model, persistence, browser, and log privacy.
Verify ambiguous delivery remains unknown without resend.
Verify Telegram, ledger, API, and dashboard parity.
out_of_scope: Changing the pinned release.
Destructive production failure injection or restore.
Targeting the legacy service.
Performance, cost, or repeated evaluation studies.

work survives, health recovers, and one logical delivery occurs.

stories.title: Assess and sign off the slice
stories.user_story: As the product owner, I want one redacted evidence index and final assessment, so that the slice is shipped only when every required scenario passes.
stories.why_now: S1–S28 have run against one immutable deployment; only evidence integrity and sign-off remain.
in_scope: Verify one release identity across S01-12a through S01-12c.
Validate every required artifact and scenario.
Complete evidence.md for S1–S28.
Record environment, migrations, limitations, deviations, and execution modes.
Scan all evidence and browser artifacts for prohibited data.
Record PM and independent QA sign-off.
Keep the slice unshipped and return any failure to its owner story.
out_of_scope: New deployment or release candidate.
Product fixes inside release sign-off.
Weakened criteria or relabeled failures.
Formal evaluation, cost, or performance systems.

acceptance_criteria.then: every artifact names the same source, deployment, service, environment, domain, and migrations.
every required artifact parses, links, names its execution mode, and records result honestly.
it indexes scenarios, environment, gates, deployment, migrations, limitations, deviations, and result.
no secret, owner identity, OAuth material, webhook, Calendar detail, unrelated event, or unrelated conversation is retained.
OAuth expiry, at-most-once bias, immutable targets, stale-after-confirmation Calendar state, and deviations are visible.
the slice remains unshipped and the defect returns to its owner.
the slice is recorded shipped at the immutable release without product changes.

squad.rationale: Final status requires scope, retained-visual, provenance, and independent evidence sign-off.
